method: Static current-source definitions and acquisition-path audit; not a 139-item runtime collection test.

entries.name: Sword
entries.effect: A hopeful little blade. Deals 2 HP per hit. Cuts bushes and bats seeds back.
entries.acquisition: New-run starting equipment.
entries.metadata_description: A hopeful little blade. Deals 2 HP per hit. Cuts bushes and bats seeds back.

entries.name: Bark Shield
entries.effect: Hold it toward a threat. Blocks frontal bites and seeds. Your back stays exposed.
entries.acquisition: New-run starting equipment.
entries.metadata_description: Hold it toward a threat. Blocks frontal bites and seeds. Your back stays exposed.

entries.name: Gilded Shield
entries.effect: Green wood and gold trim. Uses the same frontal guard as the Bark Shield.
entries.acquisition: Award Mirror Shield; its upgrade flag selects the green-and-gold picture.
entries.metadata_description: Green wood and gold trim. Uses the same frontal guard as the Bark Shield.

entries.name: Blightseeds
entries.effect: Hold then release to throw; a tap drops. Bursts on ground impact, opens cracked walls and deals 8 HP.
entries.acquisition: Forest seed trial, Cream trial 1, or eligible reward pool.
entries.metadata_description: Hold then release to throw; a tap drops. Bursts on ground impact, opens cracked walls and deals 8 HP.

entries.name: Grail Lamp
entries.effect: Burns webs and thorns; lights censers. Fire strips mummy wrappings and harms susceptible creatures.
entries.acquisition: Forest flame trial, Cream trial 2, or eligible reward pool.
entries.metadata_description: Burns webs and thorns; lights censers. Fire strips mummy wrappings and harms susceptible creatures.

entries.name: Petal Cloak
entries.effect: Use while moving to leap a gap. Land on safe ground beyond the hole.
entries.acquisition: Forest petal trial, Cream trial 3, or eligible reward pool.
entries.metadata_description: Use while moving to leap a gap. Land on safe ground beyond the hole.

entries.name: Root Gauntlet
entries.effect: Worn, not equipped. Press R beside a boulder to lift it; throw it for 4 HP.
entries.acquisition: Forest gauntlet chest; Power Bracelets reward/Cream chest.
entries.metadata_description: Worn, not equipped. Press R beside a boulder to lift it; throw it for 4 HP.

entries.name: Thorn Bow
entries.effect: Fires along your facing. Each arrow costs one shot and deals 2 enemy HP.
entries.acquisition: Forest bow chest; eligible rewards; Cream chest.
entries.metadata_description: Fires along your facing. Each arrow costs one shot and deals 2 enemy HP.

entries.name: Drain Cap
entries.effect: Equip and use it to return to the Drain. The way home waits beneath your feet.
entries.acquisition: In the pack at the start of every new run.
entries.metadata_description: Equip and use it to return to the Drain. The way home waits beneath your feet.

entries.name: Map of the Wood
entries.effect: Reveals every room's shape on the map. Discover features to learn their marks.
entries.acquisition: Forest map chest or Map of the Wood reward.
entries.metadata_description: Reveals every room's shape on the map. Discover features to learn their marks.

entries.name: Astrolabe
entries.effect: Adds chests, the Heart and barriers to the map. Brass remembers the hidden ways.
entries.acquisition: Forest astrolabe chest; Compass reward provides the same marker flag.
entries.metadata_description: Adds chests, the Heart and barriers to the map. Brass remembers the hidden ways.

entries.name: The Relic
entries.effect: A precious thing from another chamber. Return it to the Weeping Nun.
entries.acquisition: Physical Forest relic; return to the Weeping Nun.
entries.metadata_description: A precious thing from another chamber. Return it to the Weeping Nun.

entries.name: Piece of Heart
entries.effect: Four quarters grow one whole heart. A little life is still worth finding.
entries.acquisition: Chests, mystery rooms, NPC quests, exchange or reward pool.
entries.metadata_description: Four quarters grow one whole heart. A little life is still worth finding.

entries.name: Heart Container
entries.effect: Adds one heart to maximum health. One whole player heart holds 8 HP.
entries.acquisition: Forest chest or Nun quest; eligible reward pool.
entries.metadata_description: Adds one heart to maximum health. One whole player heart holds 8 HP.

entries.name: Small Key
entries.effect: Walk into a locked door to spend one key. A large keyhole shows its purpose.
entries.acquisition: Key chests, quest drops and loose key pickups.
entries.metadata_description: Walk into a locked door to spend one key. A large keyhole shows its purpose.

entries.name: Heart
entries.effect: A loose heart restores 8 HP: one whole player heart. Gather it by touch or sword.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary enemy/cleared-object drop rolls.
entries.metadata_description: A loose heart restores 8 HP: one whole player heart. Gather it by touch or sword.

entries.name: Gilt
entries.effect: A little glimmer worth one gilt. Spend it at the frog's market in the Drain.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary enemy/cleared-object drop rolls.
entries.metadata_description: A little glimmer worth one gilt. Spend it at the frog's market in the Drain.

entries.name: Purse of Gilt
entries.effect: A dropped purse holds 10 gilt. Larger chest rewards may hold more. Carry up to 999.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary drops, placed hoards, quests and gilt chest awards.
entries.metadata_description: A dropped purse holds 10 gilt. Larger chest rewards may hold more. Carry up to 999.

entries.name: Blightseed Refill
entries.effect: A dropped refill adds three seeds if you own blightseeds. Carry up to 30.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary drop rolls after Bombs are owned.
entries.metadata_description: A dropped refill adds three seeds if you own blightseeds. Carry up to 30.

entries.name: Arrow
entries.effect: Adds one shot for the Thorn Bow. Walls stop arrows. Carry up to 50 shots.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary drop rolls after the Thorn Bow is owned.
entries.metadata_description: Adds one shot for the Thorn Bow. Walls stop arrows. Carry up to 50 shots.

entries.name: Five Arrows
entries.effect: A small tied bundle adds five shots. Ammunition never exceeds 50.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary drop rolls after the Thorn Bow is owned.
entries.metadata_description: A small tied bundle adds five shots. Ammunition never exceeds 50.

entries.name: Ten Arrows
entries.effect: A full bundle adds ten shots. The frog sells these once you have a bow.
entries.acquisition: Ordinary bow-owned drops; frog market sells ten for 10 gilt.
entries.metadata_description: A full bundle adds ten shots. The frog sells these once you have a bow.

entries.name: The Grail
entries.effect: The Heart releases this when it falls. Claim the Grail to finish the journey.
entries.acquisition: Dropped by the Forest Blight Heart; collect it to win.
entries.metadata_description: The Heart releases this when it falls. Claim the Grail to finish the journey.

entries.name: Healing Petal
entries.effect: The frog's preserved snack costs 10 gilt and restores two player hearts.
entries.acquisition: Frog market: 10 gilt; heals 16 HP/two hearts.
entries.metadata_description: The frog's preserved snack costs 10 gilt and restores two player hearts.

entries.name: Hopeful Sword
entries.effect: A hopeful edge. Cuts brush, strikes enemies and turns marked switches.
entries.acquisition: Starting equipment; synchronized from the original Sword flag.
entries.metadata_description: A hopeful edge. Cuts brush, strikes enemies and turns marked switches.

entries.name: Enduring Blade
entries.effect: A run blessing enables learned Sword Beam at any health. When awarded with Sword Beam already learned, handoff_apply_item_effect returns before ordinary sword_level promotion.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 1). Sword Beam learned; its run blessing has not already been taken.
entries.metadata_description: A green sword; with Sword Beam learned, it grants beams at any health.

entries.name: Red Sword
entries.effect: Sets sword level to at least 2; charged spin damage becomes 6. Ordinary sword cuts retain their base damage before other blessings.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 1). Also eligible extended-market stock.
entries.metadata_description: A stronger red edge. Its charged spin strikes harder.

entries.name: Blue Sword
entries.effect: Sets sword level to at least 3; charged spin damage becomes 8. Ordinary sword cuts retain their base damage before other blessings.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 2). Also eligible extended-market stock. Red Sword owned.
entries.metadata_description: A brilliant blue edge. Its charged spin is fiercer still. Requires the Red Sword.

entries.name: Dull Edge
entries.effect: A curse: every outgoing hit loses one damage, to a minimum of one.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 1).
entries.metadata_description: A curse: every outgoing hit loses one damage, to a minimum of one.

entries.name: Fourfold Sword
entries.effect: Sets sword level 4 and enables split-pad charging for up to three companions; companions copy real attacks and activate clone mechanisms.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 2). Also eligible extended-market stock. Blue Sword owned for the random pool; also a Four-Seal completion reward.
entries.metadata_description: An edge that divides. Charge on split pads to form up to three companions.

entries.name: Bombs
entries.effect: Tap to drop, or hold to throw. Half a second throws a tile and a half; one second reaches two tiles. Bursts on impact.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 0). Also eligible extended-market stock. Also the Forest seed trial and Cream trial 1.
entries.metadata_description: Tap to drop, or hold to throw. Half a second throws a tile and a half; one second reaches two tiles. Bursts on impact.

entries.name: Remote Blightseeds
entries.effect: Throw and land armed seeds. Use the button again to detonate your placed remote seeds.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 1). Also eligible extended-market stock. Bombs owned.
entries.metadata_description: Throw and land armed seeds. Use the button again to detonate your placed remote seeds.

entries.name: Thorn Bow
entries.effect: Fires a thorn arrow in the direction you face. Each shot costs one arrow.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 0). Also eligible extended-market stock. Also Forest bow chests and Cream chests.
entries.metadata_description: Fires a thorn arrow in the direction you face. Each shot costs one arrow.

entries.name: Light Arrow
entries.effect: A swift, luminous arrow pierces enemies. Shares your ordinary arrow supply.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 2). Also eligible extended-market stock. Thorn Bow owned.
entries.metadata_description: A swift, luminous arrow pierces enemies. Shares your ordinary arrow supply.

entries.name: Boomerang
entries.effect: Throw to stun, strike switches and fetch loose pickups. It always returns.
entries.acquisition: Eligible regional event/quest/cache rewards (pool tier 0). Also eligible extended-market stock. Also Cream chests.
entries.metadata_description: Throw to stun, strike switches and fetch loose pickups. It always returns.

entries.metadata_description: A longer flight you can steer with the direction buttons. Returns with loose pickups.
